pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Anglo-French rivalry / Carnatic wars

patterns: APPSC asks one-line identification: ijaradari = revenue farming (Murshid Quli), Clive = founder of the British Empire in India.
Other PSCs test Murshid Quli as last Mughal-appointed Subahdar and Plassey vs Buxar as 'first decisive' (Plassey) or 'most decisive' (Buxar) - wording decides the key.
Likely traps: Sarfaraz was Shuja-ud-din's son; Black Hole narrator Holwell, 20 June 1756; Treaty of Alinagar restored 1717 privileges.
App MCQs are sound and close to PYQ depth; they add chronology and multi-statement items not yet seen in APPSC.
